ResearchProjectDef.label: beam optics
ResearchProjectDef.description: Turn electricity into a coherent beam and back again, using the same photovoltaic know-how as solar panels. Unlocks the beam emitter, beam receiver, beam mirror and beam window.

ResearchProjectDef.label: beam safety
ResearchProjectDef.description: Motion-sensing gates, built on autodoor technology, that cut a beam the moment someone steps into it. Unlocks the beam safety shutter.

ResearchProjectDef.label: beam splitting
ResearchProjectDef.description: Half-silvered optics and crystal prisms that split one beam into several and share the power between them, steered by microelectronic controllers. Unlocks the beam splitter and the beam prism.

ResearchProjectDef.label: coherent relays
ResearchProjectDef.description: Gather scattered beams, re-collimate them and fire them onward at full range. Needs precision parts from fabrication. Unlocks the beam relay.

ResearchProjectDef.label: beam capacitors
ResearchProjectDef.description: Bank beam power in the network itself, using battery chemistry, so it keeps flowing when emitters can't keep up. Unlocks the beam capacitor.
